title: Interfacial synergy of pre-lithiation silicon anodes and GNP/MnO2/S cathodes for lithium polysulfides in silicon–sulfur batteries studied via DFT
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2137-2148
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00125K, Paper
Navid Aslfattahi, Maryam Sadat Kiai, Deniz Karatas, Nilgun Baydogan, Lingenthiran Samylingam, Kumaran Kadirgama, Chee Kuang Kok
This study presents a straightforward approach for designing silicon/graphene nanoplates as an anode material using a one-step hydrothermal process. Additionally, to reduce the shuttle effect, the GNP/MnO2/S cathode is investigated.
